metadata.title: Acme Health intake: SOC 2 control selection (via NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5)
metadata.remarks: Selects the NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 controls that the SOC 2 criteria implemented (or planned) by the Acme Health intake component map to: CC6.1 -> sc-28, CC6.3 -> ac-6, CC6.6 -> sc-7, CC6.7 -> sc-8, A1.2 -> cp-9, CC7.2 -> si-4. AICPA publishes no official OSCAL catalog for the Trust Services Criteria, so NIST 800-53 Rev 5 is the catalog and the SOC 2 criterion is carried as a prop on each implemented-requirement. Each pair was checked against the AICPA crosswalk 'Mapping: 2017 Trust Services Criteria to NIST 800-53' (r5).
